title: Ombudsman column: The Pentagon is trying to silence me
summary: A former Stars and Stripes ombudsman claims the Pentagon is attempting to silence their ability to report on military matters and address reader complaints, raising concerns about press freedom and government transparency within military-affiliated media.
problem_solved: Addresses allegations of government censorship and threats to independent military journalism oversight.
why_valuable: Highlights critical issues around transparency, accountability, and First Amendment concerns within military media operations.
